title: Segment after dropping and taking entries
statement: Let $\mu : \mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of natural numbers. Suppose $\mu(a+i)$ equals the integer represented by $l_i$ for every index $i<|l|$. For any natural numbers $lo$ and $w$, the values of $\mu$ starting at $a+lo$ agree with the natural-number entries, viewed as integers, of the list formed by dropping the first $lo$ entries of $l$ and then taking the first $w$ entries.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ agrees with the entries of $l$, viewed as integers, at every index in the segment starting at $a$
